title: Cell Tower Connection Logs by Carrier
summary: Timestamps and tower IDs when a phone registers with the network; controlled by carriers (AT&T, Vodafone) and retained 1–7 years.

title: Supermarket Loyalty Card Purchase Sequences
summary: Itemized transaction histories linked to a named account; controlled by retailers (Kroger, Tesco) and sold to data brokers.

title: DNS Query Logs at ISP Level
summary: Domain lookups made by subscribers, timestamped and IP-linked; controlled by ISPs and resolver operators (Cloudflare, Google).

title: Elevator Usage Patterns in Office Buildings
summary: Call logs from building management systems, timestamped and floor-linked; controlled by elevator companies (Otis, KONE) and building owners.

title: Credit Card Transaction Location and Merchant Category Sequences
summary: Purchase time, merchant, amount, and MCC code; controlled by card networks (Visa, Mastercard) and issuing banks.

title: Google Search Query Logs by Account
summary: Verbatim queries, timestamps, and result clicks; controlled by Google and not externally accessible.

title: Email Header Metadata (To, From, Subject, Timestamp, IP)
summary: Communication graph and timing without message content; collected by email providers and accessible to intelligence agencies.

title: Ride-Hailing Trip Origin-Destination Pairs (Uber, Lyft)
summary: Pickup/dropoff coordinates, duration, and fare; controlled by platform operators and occasionally subpoenaed.

title: Court E-Filing System Access Logs
summary: Who queried which case records and when; controlled by PACER and state court systems, not publicly released.

title: Hospital EHR Login and Chart Access Logs
summary: Which staff member opened which patient record and when; controlled by hospital IT departments and audited internally.

title: Mortgage Application Denial Records by Census Tract (HMDA)
summary: Loan application outcomes by race, income, and geography under the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act; public annual release.

title: Corporate Procurement System Order Histories
summary: Vendor, quantity, price, and delivery timing from ERP systems (SAP, Oracle); controlled by corporations and occasionally revealed in litigation.

title: Wikipedia Article Edit Histories
summary: All revisions, diffs, editor usernames and IPs, and timestamps; fully public via Wikimedia dumps.

title: Airline Ticketing and Boarding Records (PNR Data)
summary: Passenger name, routing, seat, and payment method; controlled by airlines and GDSs (Amadeus, Sabre) and shared with border agencies.

title: Smartphone App Foreground/Background Usage Logs
summary: Which app is active, for how long, and at what time; controlled by OS makers (Apple, Google) and aggregated by analytics firms.

title: Workers' Compensation Claims by Employer and Industry
summary: Injury type, body part, employer, and claim cost; controlled by state labor agencies and variably public.

title: ATM Withdrawal Location and Amount Logs
summary: Cash transaction records linked to account; controlled by banks and card networks and retained for years.

title: Academic Literature Citation Networks
summary: Who cited whom, extracted from reference lists; aggregated by Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, and Web of Science.

title: Prescription Drug Dispensing Records by Pharmacy
summary: Drug, dose, prescriber, patient, and date; controlled by pharmacies and PBMs (CVS Caremark, Express Scripts) and partially accessible via state PDMPs.

title: Container Ship AIS Position and Port Call Logs
summary: Vessel identity, position, and speed from mandatory transponders; aggregated by MarineTraffic with cargo correlated via UN Comtrade.

title: Public Transit Fare Gate Tap Records
summary: Card ID, station entry/exit, and time; controlled by transit agencies (TfL, MTA) and retained for dispute resolution.

title: Corporate Email Server Send/Receive Logs (SMTP Metadata)
summary: Internal communication graph and timing; controlled by IT departments and email security vendors (Proofpoint, Mimecast).

title: Payday Loan and High-Interest Credit Application Records
summary: Application volume, approval rates, and loan terms by zip code; controlled by lenders and partially reported to CFPB.

title: Real Estate Title Transfer Records
summary: Buyer, seller, price, date, and deed type; controlled by county recorder offices and partially aggregated by PropStream and ATTOM.

title: Hotel Key-Card Door Entry Logs
summary: Room access timestamps for each guest key; controlled by hotel property management systems (Oracle OPERA) and retained briefly.

title: Government Employee Time-and-Attendance Records
summary: Clock-in/out, leave type, supervisor, and agency; controlled by OPM and agency HR systems in the US.

title: E-Commerce Return Reason Codes
summary: Product return category, stated reason, and processing outcome; controlled by platforms (Amazon, Shopify merchants) and proprietary.

title: Court Appearance and Warrant Records in Municipal Systems
summary: Failure-to-appear rates and warrant issuance by judge and zip code; controlled by municipal courts and rarely aggregated.

title: Social Media Posting Timestamps and Device Metadata
summary: When and from what device a post was created; controlled by platforms (Meta, X) and partially available via API.

title: Eviction Filing Records by Landlord and Courthouse
summary: Filing frequency, outcomes, and property address; controlled by courts and aggregated by Princeton Eviction Lab and local journalists.

title: VPN Provider Connection Logs
summary: Session start/end, IP assignment, and data volume; controlled by VPN operators with retention varying widely.

title: Student LMS Interaction Logs (Canvas, Blackboard)
summary: Page views, assignment submissions, and video watch times; controlled by universities and LMS vendors.

title: Health Insurance Claim Denial Patterns by Insurer and ICD Code
summary: Denial rates by diagnosis and procedure; controlled by insurers and partially reported under ACA to CMS.

title: Prison Phone Call Records (Securus, ICSolutions)
summary: Duration, parties, and timestamps of inmate calls; controlled by prison telecom vendors and sold to law enforcement.

title: Trucking ELD (Electronic Logging Device) Records
summary: Hours of service, location, and speed from mandated FMCSA devices; controlled by carriers and ELD vendors.

title: Dark Pattern Interaction Logs on E-Commerce Checkout Pages
summary: Click paths, exit rates, and time-on-page near forced subscription opt-ins; controlled by platforms and proprietary.

title: Restaurant Point-of-Sale Item and Table Turn Data
summary: Menu item sales, table occupancy, and server ID; controlled by POS vendors (Toast, Square) and restaurant owners.

title: Immigration Court Hearing Continuance Logs
summary: Reasons for delay, requesting party, judge, and outcome; controlled by EOIR and partially accessible via FOIA.

title: Streaming Service Viewing Duration and Dropout Points
summary: Exact timestamps when users paused, rewound, or stopped; controlled by platforms (Netflix, Spotify) and proprietary.

title: Police Dispatch CAD Logs
summary: Call type, address, unit assigned, response time, and disposition; controlled by police departments and partially obtainable via public records requests.

title: Supply Chain Sub-Tier Purchase Orders
summary: Contracts between tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers below brand visibility; controlled by suppliers and rarely visible to auditors or brands.

title: Political Campaign Donor Geographic Clustering
summary: Donation sequences by address over time, cross-referenced with FEC filings; partially public via FEC bulk data.

title: Gambling Transaction Sequences at Casino Floors
summary: Bet size, game type, time, and loyalty card ID; controlled by casinos and gaming commissions and rarely public.

title: Search and Rescue Mission Logs by Coast Guard District
summary: Incident type, position, vessel, and outcome; controlled by USCG and partially public.

title: Internal Corporate Slack/Teams Message Metadata
summary: Sender, recipient, channel, timestamp, and reaction count without message content; controlled by employers and Microsoft/Salesforce.

title: Parking Meter Payment Records by Block Face
summary: Payment time, duration, and location; controlled by municipalities and parking management vendors (ParkMobile, Conduent).

title: Emergency Room Triage Queue Wait Times by Chief Complaint
summary: Time-stamped acuity assignments; controlled by hospital ED systems and rarely aggregated regionally.

title: Gig Economy Algorithmic Task Assignment Logs
summary: Which worker was offered which task, at what price, and after which factors; controlled by platforms (DoorDash, Amazon Flex) and never disclosed.

title: Landlord Blacklist Database Entries (Tenant Screening)
summary: Names submitted to tenant screening databases (SafeRent, CoreLogic) and dispute outcomes; controlled by screening companies with no public audit.

title: Social Credit and Behavior Scoring in Private Platforms
summary: Internal risk or trustworthiness scores applied to users by platforms (Airbnb, Uber) affecting access; not disclosed to subjects.
